states: Isolated worktree backend with two genuinely enrolled agents (macOS host agent plus a colima Linux VM agent) whose API tokens were then revoked over the real settings API, producing a real two-installation credential-repair state with both connections reporting credentialStatus invalid.

The Generate update token section rendered the multiple-repair guidance and the installation selector as the shared labelled FormSelect primitive: a visible 'Agent installation to repair' label associated to the select via label[for] matching the select id, replacing the previous aria-label-only raw select.

After minting a token for the selected installation, the selected agent's detail exposed its host-local repair command with the fresh scoped credential embedded while the unselected installation stayed locked with the select-this-installation-above guidance.
At 390x844 the Agent Doctor document scroll width measured exactly 390 pixels with the labelled selector rendered full-width inside the token section.
interactions: Logged in and opened the Agent Doctor at 1440x900 with two critical credential-repair targets present.
Changed the installation selector from triage-mac-01 to triage-vm-01 and confirmed the select value, selected option text, and visible associated label via DOM inspection.

Clicked Generate token for the selected installation, then expanded both agent rows and verified the per-installation unlock: triage-vm-01's command carried the embedded token and triage-mac-01 remained gated.
Resized to 390x844, reloaded, and re-verified the labelled selector rendering and a 390-pixel document scroll width against the 390-pixel viewport.
